articles.summary: This collaboration will modernize fulfillment and service, and unify inventory to better serve shoppers across Boscov’s 51 stores and their ecommerce operations ATLANTA --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 1, 2026-- Manhattan Associates Inc. (NASDAQ: MANH) and Boscov’s Department Store, LLC.
articles.title: Boscov’s to Transform their Omnichannel Fulfillment and Customer Service Operations with Manhattan Associates
